answer: A farm faking 141 aliases needs 141 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Street performer licence works as the check: a licence the council renews after busked pitches. The echo check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The tide record is public, the fable cost is per identity, and 141 aliases cost 141 times one honest seat.
